tools.name: superchat_get_me
tools.description: Get the user that owns the API token. Useful first call to confirm the connection. Superchat API: GET /me.

tools.name: superchat_list_conversations
tools.description: List conversations in the workspace (customer threads across channels). Superchat API: GET /conversations.

tools.name: superchat_get_conversation
tools.description: Get one conversation by id, including its status and assignment. Superchat API: GET /conversations/{conversation_id}.

tools.name: superchat_list_conversation_messages
tools.description: List the messages of one conversation, in the order the API returns them. Read only: does not send messages. Superchat API: GET /conversations/{conversation_id}/messages.

tools.name: superchat_get_message
tools.description: Get one message by id. Superchat API: GET /messages/{message_id}.

tools.name: superchat_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (customer records) in the workspace. Superchat API: GET /contacts.

tools.name: superchat_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id, including its custom attributes. Superchat API: GET /contacts/{contact_id}.

tools.name: superchat_list_contact_conversations
tools.description: List the conversations of one contact. Superchat API: GET /contacts/{contact_id}/conversations.

tools.name: superchat_list_contact_lists
tools.description: List the contact lists (segments) of the workspace. Superchat API: GET /contact-lists.

tools.name: superchat_list_channels
tools.description: List the connected channels (WhatsApp, email, chat and others). Superchat API: GET /channels.

tools.name: superchat_get_channel
tools.description: Get one channel by id. Superchat API: GET /channels/{channel_id}.

tools.name: superchat_list_inboxes
tools.description: List the inboxes of the workspace. Superchat API: GET /inboxes.

tools.name: superchat_list_users
tools.description: List the users (team members) of the workspace. Superchat API: GET /users.

tools.name: superchat_list_labels
tools.description: List the labels that tag conversations. Superchat API: GET /labels.

tools.name: superchat_list_custom_attributes
tools.description: List the custom attribute definitions used on contacts. Superchat API: GET /custom-attributes.

tools.name: superchat_list_templates
tools.description: List the message templates of the workspace. Read only. Superchat API: GET /templates.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: superchat_list_conversations, superchat_list_conversation_messages, superchat_get_message, superchat_list_channels, superchat_list_templates · Private data: superchat_get_me, superchat_list_contacts, superchat_get_contact, superchat_list_contact_conversations, superchat_list_contact_lists, superchat_list_custom_attributes · Public sink: superchat_list_conversation_messages, superchat_list_channels.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: superchat_list_conversations, superchat_list_conversation_messages, superchat_get_message, superchat_list_channels, superchat_list_templates · Private data: superchat_get_me, superchat_list_contacts, superchat_get_contact, superchat_list_contact_conversations, superchat_list_contact_lists, superchat_list_custom_attributes · Public sink: superchat_list_conversation_messages, superchat_list_channels

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
